slides.title: Close the month in **3 days**, not 9
slides.sub: Four habits from 14 small shops. No software.

slides.title: Why month end takes 9 days
slides.body: Every refund, double charge and deposit with no note becomes 20 minutes of detective work, because nobody remembers it a month later.

slides.title: 1. Reconcile every morning
slides.bad: One big match at month end
slides.good: 10 minutes with the bank feed, a one-line note for anything odd

slides.title: 2. One receipts inbox
slides.bad: Shoebox, phone, supplier portal and email
slides.good: One address for receipts only. Not in by Friday, it does not exist

slides.title: 3. Close on a calendar
slides.bad: We close when everything is in
slides.good: Day 1 bank, day 2 bills, day 3 report. Missing items get a note

slides.title: 4. One page, one call
slides.good: Cash, what changed, what needs a decision. Then a 15-minute call

slides.title: It shows the problem sooner
slides.body: Two of the 14 shops still have a cash problem. They see it 6 days earlier, which is the only way to fix it.

slides.title: Start with the 10 minutes
slides.body: Save this for the last week of the month and try the morning match for two weeks.
